Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3163; peaceable:--not a brawler.
BiblicalUsage: Twice, and both times in the character of a leader: not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous. And again, to speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men. The word is peaceable, not a fighter, and Paul puts it in the list twice because the church needs it twice.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for peaceable carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the place it holds, that the man who leads God's people must not be a man who likes a fight.
